confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are based on aggregated crowd-sourced cost-of-living figures for Brasov (about 46 RON for an inexpensive meal, about 14 RON for a cappuccino, about 12 RON for a domestic beer), adjusted slightly upward for the July 2026 peak tourist season. The mid-range meal for two is a model estimate scaled from the inexpensive-meal figure. I didn't check cocktail and wine prices directly. They are estimated from the local price relationship to beer and typical Romanian bar pricing, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are general model estimates for summer high season in Brasov, not taken from live listings, and are the least certain anchors. The RBA rate came from a search summary that cited the RBA rate for 18 Nov 2026. I didn't open the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Cluj-Napoca and Sibiu, which are Romanian tourist cities of similar size. Brasov's old town and its role as a Carpathian tourism hub push prices toward the upper end for Romanian cities outside Bucharest.
